run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using SLURM job scheduler
run_benchmark_with_fixed_atoms: run a benchmark sweep with fixed atom counts across multiple GPU counts using the sweep script
run_benchmark_with_per_gpu_atoms: run a benchmark sweep with per-GPU atom counts that scale with GPU count using the sweep script
calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
generate_scaling_plots: generate weak and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results for model performance analysis
